decisions.reason: Although it uses the firm's lighting know-how, the medical examination light sits in a more specialised and less core segment than the firm's main professional building and industrial lighting business, so I would reallocate resources to stronger strategic areas.
The designer task light was a relaunch of a previously popular product and remains close enough to the firm's professional workplace offering to justify continued support.
A pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core commercial lighting business and the market trend toward efficient workplace LED solutions, so it should remain in the range.
The premium pendant luminaire line matches the firm's established offer and broader multi-model commitment, making it worth keeping unless demand clearly weakens.
